description: HEC-HMS 4.13 — USACE Hydrologic Modeling System for watershed rainfall-runoff simulation (Java Swing app on macOS)
main_window: Three-pane layout: left panel (project/component tree), upper-right canvas (basin map, blue), lower-right panel (component details). Title bar shows project path when open.
ax_notes: Java Swing app — AXTitle/AXDescription are blank on most elements. Use AX tree index (sorted by y then x) to identify buttons. Use AppleScript for typing into text fields. Always call app.activate() before interacting.

key_elements.name: Project dropdown
key_elements.location: toolbar row 1 — shows active project name

workflows.name: Create new project
steps: 2. Verify dialog: check app.windows() for 'Create a New Project'
3. Click Name field center via pyautogui.click(field.AXPosition.x + width/2, field.AXPosition.y + height/2)
4. Type via AppleScript: osascript -e 'tell application "System Events" to tell process "HEC-HMS-4.13" to keystroke "a" using command down' then keystroke the project name
6. Collect AXButton elements from dialog, sort by (y, x). Button index 5 = CREATE (left ~84x29), index 6 = CANCEL (right ~86x29)

workflows.name: Open existing project
steps: 2. Navigate file dialog to .hms file and open

workflows.name: Run a simulation
steps: 1. Select simulation run from dropdown (toolbar row 3)
